_doc: Which event file drives each instrument's machines (C3). Written by scripts/event_sources.py; the measurements are in timing/event_sources.md.

vocals.why: forced alignment of the as-sung lyrics

suno_midi_offset_s.why: Suno's MIDI runs early against its stems; the median is applied to every Suno note and to its tempo map

keyboard.why: coverage 0.75 (suno 0.64, basic-pitch 0.76, union 0.75); shift +3.6 ms; 13 ghosts and 6 inactive-section events and 461 bleed events dropped

percussion.why: coverage 0.54 (suno 0.21, basic-pitch 0.53, union 0.54); shift +3.1 ms; 119 ghosts and 25 inactive-section events and 123 bleed events dropped

guitar.drives: fingerstyle guitar: bass notes and chords (no machine assigned yet)

bass.why: coverage 0.68 (suno 0.55, basic-pitch 0.71, union 0.68); shift +9.9 ms; 14 ghosts and 2 inactive-section events and 3 bleed events dropped

music_box.drives: music box comb (and the stars: see config/event_sources.json)

stars.why: the brief places each new star on a celesta note; the human hears no celesta (the Percussion stem is half the music box), so stars are proposed on the music box's top-line notes (C3; decided at C4)
